observations: The product is CC(=O)N1CCn2nc(N)cc2C1; the fused N-acetyl scaffold is retained during nitro-to-amino conversion.

entities.name: ORD nitro reduction
observations: ORD reaction ord-9c002d67ddf14934a8ceef94c2700c37 converts an aromatic nitro group to an amino group; both N–O bonds are lost and the carbon framework is retained.
